title: Perplexity announces a feature that lets Perplexity Computer split tasks between on-device AI models and server-based models (Zac Hall/9to5Mac)
summary: Zac Hall / 9to5Mac: Perplexity announces a feature that lets Perplexity Computer split tasks between on-device AI models and server-based models — Perplexity has announced a major new feature coming soon to Perplexity Computer: the ability to split tasks between local and cloud models.
